scenes.problem: Divide 1.2 by 0.3. Show the equal scaling and quotient digits.
rows: Choose 10^1 so multiplying BOTH original operands clears both decimal points.
Apply the same factor: 1.2 ÷ 0.3 = 12 ÷ 3. The quotient is unchanged.
Bring down 1: 1 ÷ 3 gives digit 0; subtract 0 × 3 to leave remainder 1.
Bring down 2: 12 ÷ 3 gives digit 4; subtract 4 × 3 to leave remainder 0.
Read the quotient digits with the decimal point: 4.
scenes.memo: 4 × 0.3 = 1.2, so division reverses to the original dividend.
scenes.misconception: Multiply dividend and divisor by the SAME power of ten; track every quotient digit and remainder.
